handback.title: Each release takes its version from the changelog
handback.summary: Dokima can release only v0.1.0, so adopters never get later fixes.
handback.user_story: Adding a new version section to the changelog and merging it makes that release, and adopters run it.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the changelog's newest version heading is v0.1.1, a push to main makes the v0.1.1 release.
acceptance_criteria.words: each release names its version from the changelog's newest version heading, so adding a `## v0.1.1` section and merging it makes v0.1.1

edge_cases.case: An Unreleased section sits above v0.1.1: v0.1.1 is still made, without the draft lines.
The newest version is already released: nothing is made, not an older version.

acceptance_criteria.text: The changelog's newest section is v0.1.1, listing the fixes merged since v0.1.0.
acceptance_criteria.words: adding a `## v0.1.1` section and merging it makes v0.1.1
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It is one fixed file in the repo; no input varies.

acceptance_criteria.text: The install file calls Dokima at the changelog's newest version, newer than v0.1.0.
acceptance_criteria.words: the install file and the install docs name the newest release, and a test checks they match the changelog's newest version
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It is one fixed file in the repo; no input varies.

acceptance_criteria.text: The README's install steps name the newest release, the one the install file calls.
acceptance_criteria.words: the install file and the install docs name the newest release, and a test checks they match the changelog's newest version
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It is one fixed file in the repo; no input varies.

acceptance_criteria.text: The wiki's install page names the newest release, the one the install file calls.
acceptance_criteria.words: the install file and the install docs name the newest release, and a test checks they match the changelog's newest version
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It is one fixed file in the repo; no input varies.

raises.label: Ship v0.1.1 now
raises.text: Should this change also add the v0.1.1 section, so merging it releases the fixes? The plan assumes yes.
raises.evidence: The issue says #852, #856 and #861 merged after v0.1.0 and the trial #746 would run without them.
